study.question: Accepted-source audit: baseline_reference.py matches baseline-din SHA f4b473cbacf60d72cff90f3721ad754dd617ee6065fe3fca2fc9cd4be2b25c36; provided parent source matches g2-r0014-age_behavior SHA 45ba3fd484c716c3b49a334d1f4fcfbb94a5384edd04887540906b048047abbc. No raw data, executable torch or local training interface is supplied; frozen host receipts are the empirical starting point rather than a new reproduction. The parent yields click AUC 0.6633649506/Logloss 0.1824430251, versus baseline-din 0.6555440824/0.1833968026, but cart/fav/buy AUCs are 0.717323/0.746351/0.684305 versus baseline 0.849070/0.864897/0.870182. r0014 resolved age/behavior marginals yield click 0.663365 versus age_only 0.662993, behavior_only 0.662613 and totals_only 0.662259; the interaction is only about 0.0000177 and one seed gives no repeated support. Exact task masks are supplied but the parent ORs them before compression; action embeddings may implicitly retain some identity. Earlier g2-r0001-feedback_action retains high auxiliary AUCs but lower click 0.656060; g2-r0003-both_blocked improves click to 0.660041 while auxiliary quality falls, so gradient ownership is a credible competing explanation. g2-r0005-private_residual partly restores auxiliary AUCs to 0.828151/0.851593/0.848763 at 56,321,669 parameters and 435.13 seconds while click 0.660099 trails its source-gated control. g2-r0009-target10 (0.659840) did not beat history10 (0.660052); learned target compression is not assumed to help. g2-r0012-recent_forward/reverse (0.662455/0.660751) and equal_forward/reverse (0.660519/0.660850) caution that temporal allocation and content placement interact. All recorded trajectories are successful executions; unsuccessful hypotheses are negative scientific findings, not missing-data or runtime failures. Previous runtime error is null. Question: conditional on the incumbent source gates and union scorer, does retaining task-specific temporal counts and within-union field/action content improve prediction without another event-scoring pass?
study.hypothesis: Union compression conflates which historical auxiliary action occurred and which item/action content it accompanied. Task-resolved per-partition sums and counts can restore information to joint context/target/task heads even when shared item/action/scorer gradients from auxiliary tasks remain blocked. Within-union content and resolved counts are separable hypotheses; the known gradient tradeoff may dominate both.

study.proposed_difference: Build three standalone modules, one factor with three nested information replacements. Each independently forms task membership [B,3,100] in canonical cart/fav/buy order, intersected with valid history; masks may overlap. For each of the ten parent temporal partitions compute exact task counts n[t,j] and sums S[t,j] of item-field plus historical-action embeddings. Keep parent union means mu[j], counts N[j] and thirty scorer rows unchanged. task_exact uses S and n; task_centroid replaces S by n*mu while retaining identical n; task_union replaces S/counts by N*mu and N duplicated for all three tasks. All cells calculate all alternatives in forward before selecting; unused resolved tensors have no logit path. Reuse existing union-positive slot weights a[j] to expose sum_j a[j]*S[t,j], signed recent-minus-older sum and thirty unweighted counts/100. Counts are already in S: never apply n a second time. New four heads take context, target, three task totals, three age contrasts and thirty counts; width32 ReLU then scalar with zero final layer, in a separate CPU RNG fork. For auxiliary labels detach the entire task descriptor and use inherited detached target plus open context; no new item/scorer auxiliary gradient path. No new scorer, learned router, private embedding bank, timestamp, future event or current label input. Exact versus centroid estimates content retention conditional on resolved counts; centroid versus union estimates resolved-count retention through common union content. Both nominal parameter capacity and forward operators are matched among new cells, but feature rank/scale, actual backward graph and optimizer trajectories can differ. No claim of equal measured compute. Expected added parameters = 4*(32*(context_width+key_width+6*value_width+30)+65). For inherited context192/key96/value112: +126980, total32281901/dense488685/embedding31793216, to verify on host. Local syntax, AST cell parity and inherited-method identity passed; 250 independent scalar routing/algebra cases passed (not tensor checks). Before training, the host must verify finite FP32/BF16 forward/backward and four [B,1] probabilities for full/partial/empty and holey histories, B=1 evaluation and supported training batches. Exercise arbitrary FeatureMap label order; validate canonical cart/fav/buy mask mapping, overlapping masks, each task count <= union count, union formed only from valid historical positions, padded-ID and padded-task-mask invariance, and target-action exclusion. Verify [B,3,10,V] sums and [B,3,10] counts against direct masked sums, no second count multiplication, empty/missing-task zero descriptors, and count-matched exact-minus-centroid equals the weighted within-union residual. With identical parameters, all modes must agree for no auxiliary history; exact/centroid must agree if each task is either the full union or empty within each block, up to measured BF16 tolerance. Union mode must be invariant to reassignment of task identities that preserves the union and historical item/action values; exact/centroid count tensors must match exactly. Prove unused exact sums cannot reach union/centroid logits and changing modes does not change any scorer rows or persistent buffers at identical weights. Check the parent state dict is a strict subset with matching inherited parameter values and caller CPU RNG after construction; zero-output new heads must reproduce parent predictions and inherited Dice updates initially. After making new heads nonzero for gradient checks, isolated auxiliary losses must not reach item/action tables, target embeddings or scorer parameters through either old or new paths; context and auxiliary heads must receive gradients. Click loss must reach allowed item/scorer/new-head sources. Check shared-table aliases, no new embedding bank, original primary-only persistent Dice updates and zero/one-row scorer rules. predictions: Predeclared content contrast: task_exact exceeds task_centroid on validation click AUC and/or auxiliary mean AUC with identical exact task counts, consistent with useful within-union field/action association. A purely auxiliary gain is a secondary outcome, not a primary winner.

Predeclared count contrast: task_centroid exceeds task_union when resolved task prevalence/temporal placement carries information conditional on union content. No threshold or held-out outcome will select between these explanations.

At identical initialized parameters all three models reproduce the parent because new output layers are zero; same-seed parent replay is initialization verification, not an independent scientific repetition.

Predicted descriptor differences vanish for empty auxiliary history; exact-centroid differences vanish within any block where a task contains the entire union or no members. Diagnostic invariants refer to common weights, not separately trained models.

Potential gains should be explored by frozen history-length bins and task-support bins 0,1,2-4,>=5 valid historical positives (defined before scoring), reporting samples/positives/negatives per task and insufficient slices. Existing full-validation metrics are mandatory; additional slices/bootstrap require host support and are not presumed available.

Scorer row counts remain unchanged; extra 30x100 assignment/value BMM and four small heads add real cost. Any quality-cost benefit must be measured against the parent and initial DIN rather than inferred from no extra scorer pass.
falsifiers: Exact fails to beat count-matched centroid on click and auxiliary AUC/Logloss across admissible paired repetitions: no support for useful retained content in this implementation, not a universal refutation of task-specific modeling.
Centroid and exact offer no benefit over union at matched new head capacity: explicit task-mask moments are redundant, poorly optimized or unhelpful under frozen shared representations.
Task_union matches any parent-relative gain: added joint readout capacity and finer union counts explain the gain without task identity evidence.

Any padded-value dependence, task/current-label leakage, mismatched scorer population, accidental auxiliary gradient opening, source mismatch or budget violation invalidates the intended comparison irrespective of AUC.
If time/memory/latency growth erases the measured frontier benefit, no efficiency claim is supported even if quality improves.
alternative_explanations: Auxiliary quality loss may mainly reflect frozen item/action representations; explicit mask moments cannot learn task-specific sparse embeddings.

Historical action embeddings already encode some task identity. Exact content advantages could arise chiefly from the action subvector rather than item-field matching; that requires a later action-versus-item component replacement.
Task count vectors also expose fine temporal prevalence, so a count effect is conditional on this fixed temporal partition, not proof of abstract semantic task routing.
Rank, conditioning, scaling and gradient allocation differ despite identical head dimensions and forward calculations; one seed does not separate these from mechanism value.
Added context-gradient paths can change shared user/context embeddings and click quality; auxiliary gradients remain blocked only for scorer/item/action sources.
Reused union weights may be a poor approximation for rare task events; a null does not refute separately scored task histories.
Many validation-driven trials, one scratch epoch and one seed limit inference; benchmark offline feedback maturity and category/brand-based auxiliary label semantics limit transfer.
